title: One-pot reaction of 3-vinylchromones, aromatic aldehydes, and ammonium acetate: an efficient approach to highly functionalized 1,6-dihydropyridine derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2602-2607
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07863B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Behnaz Farajpour, Marzie Kakaie, Faiq H. S. Hussain, Fataneh Rakaee, Fatemeh Moradkhani, Morteza Shiri
Herein, we present an efficient method for the synthesis of functionalized 1,6-dihydropyridine derivatives. Readily available precursors, operational simplicity, and synthetically useful yields are some highlighted advantages of this transformation.
